name: Methi Paneer

ingredients.name: fresh fenugreek leaves, picked and chopped

steps: Pick only tender fenugreek leaves, wash thoroughly and drain dry. Chop them finely; discard coarse stems, which can taste bitter.
Heat oil in a wide pan and sizzle cumin. Add onions and cook 7–8 minutes until golden. Stir in ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, coriander, chili, turmeric and 5 g salt. Cook over medium heat for 8–10 minutes until the puree darkens and the oil appears at the edges.
Add chopped methi and cook uncovered for 4–5 minutes until wilted and its raw aroma fades. Pour in water and simmer 3 minutes to marry the greens with the masala.
Lower the heat. Stir in cream and paneer, then simmer gently for 3–4 minutes without boiling hard. Add remaining salt to taste and serve with chapati.
tips: Dry the washed leaves well so the curry does not become watery; cream is added only at the end.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
